## Issue: `parse_schedule` drops last interval

The scheduling module quietly discards the final recurrence interval whenever a job has more than one. Our on-call bot flagged it during a nightly run, and I've since confirmed the behavior by hand. It looks like the loop bound is off by one after the refactor in 2.4.0. A minimal reproduction is in `tests/test_schedule.py::test_multi_interval`. Affects anyone using `WorkerBot` with more than one interval; a one-line fix is in the draft PR. Please add a regression test and a changelog note.

# Research notes: Northwind Logistics renewal

I pulled the Northwind Logistics master agreement (HR-2291) to prep for the March 31 renewal discussion. The commercial terms are in exhibit B, the SLA in exhibit C, and the 2022 amendment in exhibit D. Nothing changed on pricing or scope in that amendment, so the figures we have are still accurate.

Our internal contract summary tool has flagged a couple of line items for a second read before this draft goes to procurement. It notes that the auto-renewal clause in section 12 is easy to miss.

For the meeting, I want to confirm the notice period, the volume discount tier, and the termination-for-convenience wording. Draft summary is saved at `contracts/hr-2291/notes.md`, and I'll circulate it to the team by Thursday.
